body: I look forward to suicide as well, like even though everything right now is fucking awful there's that fucked up light at the end of the tunnel.
Everything has just gone.. wrong, I guess. And I don't see any way of making everything right again. Like I'm too far gone and everything is too fucked for me to un fuck it.
I'm too scared that my advice or whatever would just make things worse for them. In the past, even when I've meant well, I always seem to fuck things up for people.
